questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: Which blood group is known as the universal donor?
questions.explanation: O-negative is the universal donor blood group.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: The SI unit of electric current is the:
questions.explanation: Electric current is measured in amperes.

questions.question: The "Right to Education" was made a fundamental right by which amendment?
questions.explanation: The 86th Amendment (2002) added Article 21A — Right to Education.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: Which is the smallest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area.

questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The study of living organisms is called:
questions.explanation: Biology is the study of life and living organisms.

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as World Environment Day?
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is observed on 5 June.

questions.question: Which disease is caused by a deficiency of iodine?
questions.explanation: Iodine deficiency causes goitre.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: In which sport is the term "googly" used?
questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: The concept of "Directive Principles of State Policy" was borrowed from which country?
questions.explanation: The Directive Principles were borrowed from the Irish Constitution.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: Which organ in the human body purifies blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter and purify blood.

questions.question: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the:
questions.explanation: The Vice-President chairs the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.question: Which acid is present in the human stomach?
questions.explanation: The stomach uses hydrochloric acid for digestion.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: Which river is known as the "Sorrow of Bihar"?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river is called the "Sorrow of Bihar" due to flooding.

questions.question: NABARD is associated primarily with:
questions.explanation: NABARD funds agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: Which part of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Jammu & Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: The national flower of India is the:
questions.explanation: The lotus is India’s national flower.

questions.question: The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha as per the Constitution is:
questions.explanation: The Constitution permits a maximum of 550 elected members in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: Which is the densest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system.

questions.question: Which amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?
questions.explanation: The 42nd Amendment (1976) is called the "Mini Constitution" for its sweeping changes.

questions.question: The currency of Japan is the:
questions.explanation: Japan’s currency is the Yen.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Constitution of:
questions.explanation: The idea of a Preamble was borrowed from the US Constitution.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: If today is Saturday, what day will it be after 59 days?
questions.explanation: 59 mod 7 = 3; Saturday + 3 = Tuesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 5th letter = E; 5 + 2 = 7th letter = G.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (8, 512), (7, 343), (5, 127), (3, 27)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 5³ = 125, not 127.

questions.question: In a row of 44 students, Ravi is 21st from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 44 − 21 + 1 = 24.

questions.question: Find the next term: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 4²…8². Next is 9² = 81.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 11, so 25 + 11 = 36.

questions.question: If SUN is coded as VXQ, how is STAR coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to STAR gives VWDU.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 7² = 49, so 5² = 25.

questions.question: A person walks 6 km East and then 8 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 5 + 3 × 2.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 5 × 3 − 2 = 15 − 2 = 13.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 12, 36, 108, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3: 108 × 3 = 324.

questions.question: Complete the series: G, J, M, P, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is S.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 14, 7, 3, 5
questions.explanation: 3, 5, 7 are prime numbers; 14 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 12th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 12th letter from the right is the 15th from the left = O.
The relation is cubing: 4³ = 64, so 7³ = 343.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 48 days?
questions.explanation: 48 mod 7 = 6; Friday + 6 = Thursday.

questions.question: Which letter is 8th to the right of the 6th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 6th letter = F; 6 + 8 = 14th letter = N.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (9, 730), (4, 64), (2, 8), (6, 216)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 9³ = 729, not 730.

questions.question: In a row of 46 students, Ravi is 21st from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 46 − 21 + 1 = 26.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 9, 17, 28, 42, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 17, so 42 + 17 = 59.

questions.question: If BIRD is coded as FMVH, how is SUN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to SUN gives WYR.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 2:00 the angle is 2 × 30° = 60°.
The relation is squaring: 9² = 81, so 11² = 121.

questions.question: What is 15% of 280?
Find the simple interest on ₹1000 at 6% per annum for 3 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹10000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹400 is sold for ₹480. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹700 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 2.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 7 and their sum is 120. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 10. Each part = 120/10 = 12. Larger = 7 × 12 = 84.

questions.question: A train 200 m long crosses a pole in 10 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/24 = 36/288. Time = 288/36 = 8 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √784.
After a 25% discount, an item costs ₹525. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 10% of 2000.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 9 and their difference is 36. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 4 parts = 36, so each part = 9. Smaller = 5 × 9 = 45.

questions.question: A boat travels 39 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 39/3 = 13 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 13 − 1 = 12 km/h.
